# AgentOS

AgentOS is a repo-local operating layer for Codex Desktop and Claude Code: an opt-in three-departments chain (三省六部) whose order is enforced by hooks on mechanical facts.

Core boundary:
- Seats (中书 / 门下 / 尚书 / executor / 御史) and their skills perform semantic judgment.
- Hooks enforce only who is calling and what the append-only task ledger says; they never classify intent from keywords.
- Unbound sessions are ordinary chat with silent hooks.

Flow:
1. The user invokes the `agentos` skill (`$agentos` Codex, `/agentos` Claude). The session becomes the relay: it records the exact words and opens `中书省｜<task>`.
2. 中书 sends the RAW increment to 门下 (Phase A independent), then its candidate (Phase B verdict), and records the contract after pass.
3. 尚书 records dispatch, creates the one-shot executor (the only writer), verifies, records integration.
4. 中书 verifies against done_when and records delivery; the relay returns it verbatim and unbinds. 御史 records confirmed mistakes in the background.

Canonical sources:
- `assets/agentos-template/agent-os/rules-card.md`: resident behavior.
- `assets/agentos-template/agent-os/workflows/{zhongshu,menxia,shangshu,executor,yushi}.md`: seat methods.
- `assets/agentos-template/agent-os/workflows/cognition.md`: the judgment procedure every seat runs.
- `assets/agentos-template/.claude/skills/agentos/SKILL.md`: the relay procedure.
- `assets/agentos-template/.claude/hooks/aos_chain_gate.py`: the shared chain gate.
- `assets/agentos-template/agent-os/adapters/codex-workflow.md`: Codex Desktop transport.

Install: `python3 scripts/install-agentos.py /path/to/project`
Validate: `python3 scripts/validate-agentos-install.py /path/to/project` and `python3 /path/to/project/agent-os/tools/aos-lint.py`

Validation proves structure only. Chain behaviour must be observed in a live, trusted runtime session.
